production_assets.seed: Deterministic formulas; no random values; version generated-demo-v1

production_assets.kind: crowd, fictional players/ball, scoreboard and boundary displays
production_assets.notes: Procedural meshes and CanvasTexture graphics; fictional score/clock, anonymous aqua/coral teams, decorative occupancy. System Arial fallback only; no font/media files bundled.

production_assets.sources: scripts/explorer-assets.json; provenance/inputs.json records CC0-PH-* and CC0-ACG-*
production_assets.notes: Processed KTX2 derivatives of approved CC0 material scans, leaf atlases and one sky HDRI in public/assets/explorer/. Originals are kept outside the repository in the git-ignored .cache/assets-src/. Each shipped file has an inventory entry with the originals' and its own SHA-256.
